foreach dtaset in small medium large {

	// load trade data
	use ${usr_data}/data_`dtaset'.dta, clear
	
	* preliminary variable definitions
	rename RTA_DGD RTA
	egen id_ci = group(exporter)
	egen id_cj = group(importer)

	* set panel IDs
	xtset id_ci_cj year, yearly

	* determine treatment cohorts
	egen first_treat=csgvar(RTA), tvar(year) ivar(id_ci_cj)

	* shift RTA/WTO 3 years forward for anticipation effects
	gen RTA_3 = F3.RTA
	egen first_treat_3=csgvar(RTA_3), tvar(year) ivar(id_ci_cj)
	gen WTO_3 = F3.WTO
	
	* define exclude dummy for three anticipation years
	gen exclude = (first_treat-1==year | first_treat-2==year | first_treat-3==year)
	
	// drop always-treated units
	drop if first_treat_3 == 1980

	// drop exits
	sort exporter importer year
	gen D_RTA = 0
	replace D_RTA = RTA-RTA[_n-1] if id_ci_cj==id_ci_cj[_n-1]
	egen exit = min(D_RTA), by(id_ci_cj)
	drop if exit==-1
	drop exit D_RTA

	// define 5-year interval
	gen int_5yr = mod(year,5)
	
	// define border-time ID
	gen brdr=1 if exporter!=importer
	replace brdr=0 if brdr==.
	egen brdr_time=group(brdr year)
	
	// define variables
	gen lnDIST = ln(DIST)
	gen lntrade = ln(trade)

	// save data set
	save ${usr_data}/data_sdid_`dtaset'.dta, replace

}

capture program drop outreg2_xlsx
program define outreg2_xlsx
    syntax, ESTIMATES(string) WORKBOOK(string) SHEET(string)         ///
        ADJdec(integer) MEANdec(integer)                             ///
        [REPLACE]

    if !inrange(`adjdec', 0, 9) | !inrange(`meandec', 0, 9) {
        display as error "adjdec() and meandec() must be integers from 0 through 9"
        exit 198
    }

    preserve
    local first = 1
    local statistic_count = 0
    local adjusted_r2_values
    local dependent_mean_values
    local scratch "$table/__outreg2_`sheet'"

    foreach estimate of local estimates {
        estimates restore `estimate'
        local ++statistic_count
        local adjusted_r2 = strtrim(strofreal(e(r2_a), "%18.`adjdec'f"))
        local dependent_mean = strtrim(strofreal(e(ymean), "%18.`meandec'f"))
        local adjusted_r2_values "`adjusted_r2_values' `adjusted_r2'"
        local dependent_mean_values "`dependent_mean_values' `dependent_mean'"
        if `first' == 1 {
            outreg2 using "`scratch'",                              ///
                replace bdec(3) sdec(3) nor2
            local first = 0
        }
        else {
            outreg2 using "`scratch'",                              ///
                append bdec(3) sdec(3) nor2
        }
    }

    import delimited using "`scratch'.txt",                         ///
        clear varnames(nonames) delimiters(tab) stringcols(_all)

    if !inlist(v1[_N - 1], "Standard errors in parentheses", "Robust standard errors in parentheses") | substr(v1[_N], 1, 3) != "***" {
        display as error "outreg2 note rows are not in the expected final positions"
        exit 498
    }
    local adjusted_r2_row = _N - 1
    local dependent_mean_row = _N
    local standard_error_note_row = _N + 1
    local significance_note_row = _N + 2
    set obs `significance_note_row'
    replace v1 = v1[`dependent_mean_row'] in `significance_note_row'
    replace v1 = v1[`adjusted_r2_row'] in `standard_error_note_row'
    replace v1 = "Adjusted R-squared" in `adjusted_r2_row'
    replace v1 = "Dep. variable mean" in `dependent_mean_row'

    local statistic_num = 0

    ds v1, not
    foreach cellvar of varlist `r(varlist)' {
        local ++statistic_num
        local adjusted_r2 : word `statistic_num' of `adjusted_r2_values'
        local dependent_mean : word `statistic_num' of `dependent_mean_values'
        if "`adjusted_r2'" == "." local adjusted_r2 ""
        replace `cellvar' = `cellvar'[`dependent_mean_row'] in `significance_note_row'
        replace `cellvar' = `cellvar'[`adjusted_r2_row'] in `standard_error_note_row'
        replace `cellvar' = "`adjusted_r2'" in `adjusted_r2_row'
        replace `cellvar' = "`dependent_mean'" in `dependent_mean_row'
    }
    if `statistic_num' != `statistic_count' {
        display as error "stored estimates and outreg2 columns do not align"
        exit 498
    }
    if "`replace'" != "" {
        export excel using "`workbook'", sheet("`sheet'") replace
    }
    else {
        export excel using "`workbook'", sheet("`sheet'", replace)
    }
    * Keep the row-label column and model columns legible without adding a
    * project-specific formatting interface.
    mata: book = xl(); book.load_book(st_local("workbook")); book.set_sheet(st_local("sheet")); book.set_column_width(1, 1, 36); book.set_column_width(2, `statistic_count' + 1, 22); book.close_book()

    restore
    erase "`scratch'.txt"
    capture confirm file "`scratch'.txt"
    if !_rc {
        display as error "outreg2 scratch file was not removed"
        exit 498
    }
end

		pc11_pca_tot_p gp_code_jj11_num gp_code_lgd21_num pc11_gp_jj11 pc11_gp_lgd21
	
	reshape long spending_sfc4_ spending_asv_ spending_brgf_ spending_nfc12_ spending_nfc13_ ///
		spending_nfc14_ spending_sfc2_ spending_sfc3_ spending_mdm_ spending_own_ spending_sn_ ///
			spending_ssa_ spending_sbm_ spending_vn_, ///
		i(gp_code_lgd21 shrid closestpop_1000 pc91_pca_tot_p pc01_pca_tot_p pc11_pca_tot_p ///
			gp_code_jj11_num gp_code_lgd21_num pc11_gp_jj11 pc11_gp_lgd21) ///
		j(year)
		
	
	gen spending_sfc_ = spending_sfc2_ + spending_sfc3_ + spending_sfc4_
	
	gen spending_nfc_ = spending_nfc12_ + spending_nfc13_ + spending_nfc14_
	drop spending_nfc12_ spending_nfc13_ spending_nfc14_
	
	gen spending_small_ = spending_asv_ + spending_brgf_ + spending_mdm_ + spending_sn_ + spending_ssa_ + spending_sbm_ + spending_vn_
	
	foreach var of varlist spending_* {
	
		gen `var'pc_ = cond( year < 2015, `var' / pc11_gp_jj11, `var' / pc11_gp_lgd21)

	}

	egen spending_total_pc_ = rowtotal(*_pc_)
		replace spending_total_pc_ = . if missing(spending_sfc_pc)
	
	
	gen village_pop_running = cond( year <= 2015, pc91_pca_tot_p, pc11_pca_tot_p)

code:
* Bind the event display once, before either loop. `event_terms' contains the
* raw e(b) event tokens, including estimator-created actual omissions; it
* excludes only the design reference. `event_order' is the same calendar order
* with exactly one literal . slot where that design reference belongs. `event_xlabels' supplies
* one explicit display label for every slot, including the reference. The
* reference marker and policy boundary are derived from that blank slot, rather
* than from a hard-coded coefficient count or row order.
local event_terms "pre_term_2 pre_term_1 post_term_1 post_term_2"
local event_order "pre_term_2 pre_term_1 . post_term_1 post_term_2"
local event_xlabels `"1 "Pre 2" 2 "Pre 1" 3 "Reference" 4 "Post 1" 5 "Post 2""'
local reference_position 3
local policy_line = `reference_position' + 0.5

* Outcomes that keep Stata's automatic y-axis
local automatic_outcomes "outcome_a outcome_b"
foreach outcome of local automatic_outcomes {
    estimates clear
    estimates use "$ster/sample_a/`outcome'_spec.ster"
    estimates store plot_sample_a
    estimates use "$ster/sample_b/`outcome'_spec.ster"
    estimates store plot_sample_b

    coefplot ///
        (plot_sample_a, label("Sample A")) ///
        (plot_sample_b, label("Sample B")), ///
        keep(`event_terms') order(`event_order') xlabel(`event_xlabels') ///
        vertical levels(95) ///
        addplot(scatteri 0 `reference_position', msymbol(O) mcolor(black)) ///
        yline(0, lcolor(gs8)) xline(`policy_line', lpattern(dash)) ///
        xtitle("Year") ytitle("Coefficient (95% CI)") ///
        title("`outcome'") ///
        legend(position(6) rows(1)) ///
        graphregion(color(white)) plotregion(color(white)) ///
        saving("$figures/`outcome'_event.gph", replace)
    graph export "$figures/`outcome'_event.pdf", replace
}

local reference_position 3
local policy_line = `reference_position' + 0.5

local all_outcomes "close_outcome_a close_outcome_b other_outcome_a other_outcome_b"
local fixed_outcomes "close_outcome_a close_outcome_b"
local axis_min  -0.10
local axis_max   0.10
local axis_step  0.05

foreach outcome of local all_outcomes {
    local axis_options ""
    if strpos(" `fixed_outcomes' ", " `outcome' ") {
        local axis_options "yscale(range(`axis_min' `axis_max') noextend) ylabel(`axis_min'(`axis_step')`axis_max')"
    }

    estimates clear
    estimates use "$ster/sample_a/`outcome'_spec.ster"
    estimates store plot_sample_a
    estimates use "$ster/sample_b/`outcome'_spec.ster"
    estimates store plot_sample_b

    coefplot ///
        (plot_sample_a, label("Sample A")) ///
        (plot_sample_b, label("Sample B")), ///
        keep(`event_terms') order(`event_order') xlabel(`event_xlabels') ///
        vertical levels(95) ///
        addplot(scatteri 0 `reference_position', msymbol(O) mcolor(black)) ///
        yline(0, lcolor(gs8)) xline(`policy_line', lpattern(dash)) ///
        `axis_options' ///
        xtitle("Year") ytitle("Coefficient (95% CI)") ///
        title("`outcome'") ///
        legend(position(6) rows(1)) ///
        graphregion(color(white)) plotregion(color(white)) ///
        saving("$figures/`outcome'_event.gph", replace)
    graph export "$figures/`outcome'_event.pdf", replace
}
